extracted.intended_audience: Department of Defense public affairs officers, communications staff, and DoD personnel responsible for preparing or clearing information for public release
extracted.subtask_description: Ensure DoD press releases, public statements, visuals, and social media posts comply with applicable DoD issuances, security and policy review requirements, privacy and records rules, and public affairs procedures listed by the Department of Defense.

rubrics_metrics.name: DODI 5230.09 — Clearance of DoD Information for Public Release
rubrics_metrics.description: Clearance of DoD Information for Public Release, January 25, 2019, with Change 1, Effective February 9, 2022 (DODI 5230.09).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Documents and statements intended for public release must follow the clearance procedures established by this issuance. Coordinate clearance with the appropriate security and policy review offices cited elsewhere in the issuances list (for example, DODI 5230.29). Review the full issuance for step-by-step clearance processes and responsible offices.

rubrics_metrics.name: DODI 5230.29 — Security and Policy Review of DoD Information for Public Release
rubrics_metrics.description: Security and Policy Review of DoD Information for Public Release, August 13, 2014, Incorporating Change 2, February 8, 2022 (DODI 5230.29).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requires security and policy review prior to release of DoD information. Use this issuance to determine classification, sensitive information, and any restrictions on release. Coordinate reviews with relevant offices (security, legal, policy) and follow the issuance for timing, documentation, and escalation procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: DODI 5400.13 — Public Affairs (PA) Operations
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Governs public affairs operations including the roles and responsibilities of PA personnel in preparing and disseminating information. Use this issuance as the foundational public affairs policy when drafting press releases, talking points, and media engagement plans; follow its guidance on coordination, approvals, and authorized spokespersons.

rubrics_metrics.name: DODI 5400.17 — Official Use of Social Media for Public Affairs Purposes
rubrics_metrics.description: Official Use of Social Media for Public Affairs Purposes, August 12, 2022, with Change 1 effective January 24, 2023 (DODI 5400.17).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Establishes policy and procedures for official DoD accounts and social media content used for public affairs. Ensure social-media posts tied to press releases adhere to platform-specific rules, account management requirements, and approval workflows described in this issuance.

rubrics_metrics.name: DoD Manual 5400.11 / DODI 5400.11 — DoD Privacy and Civil Liberties Programs
rubrics_metrics.description: DoD Privacy and Civil Liberties Programs, January 29, 2019, with Change 1 effective December 8, 2020 (DODI 5400.11) and DoD Manual 5400.11 (volume on Breach Preparedness and Response Plans, May 6, 2021).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Press releases and public products must protect personally identifiable information (PII) and respect privacy/civil liberties. Consult these issuances for breach preparedness, handling of PII, and privacy program requirements; perform Privacy Impact Assessments per referenced guidance (e.g., DODI 5400.16) when necessary.

rubrics_metrics.name: DODI 5040.02 / DODI 5040.05 — Visual Information and Alteration of Official DoD Imagery
rubrics_metrics.description: Visual Information, October 27, 2011, Incorporating Change 2, Effective April 23, 2018 (DODI 5040.02) and Alteration of Official DoD Imagery, June 6, 2006 (DODI 5040.05).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Visuals used in press releases (photos, videos, graphics) must comply with DoD visual-information policies and restrictions on alteration. Follow the issuances for standards on imagery capture, labeling, distribution statements, and prohibited alterations. Coordinate with Visual Information offices for approvals and metadata/attribution requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: DODI 5015.02 / DODI 5025.01 — DoD Records Management and Issuances Program
rubrics_metrics.description: DoD Records Management Program, February 24, 2015, Incorporating Change 1, August 17, 2017 (DODI 5015.02) and DoD Issuances Program, August 1, 2016, with Change 4, effective June 7, 2023 (DODI 5025.01).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintain records of press releases, approvals, and related correspondence in accordance with DoD records-management policy; follow the Issuances Program rules for creating, approving, and publishing official documents. Consult these issuances for retention schedules, recordkeeping responsibilities, and required metadata.

rubrics_metrics.name: DODI 5230.24 — Distribution Statements on DoD Technical Information
rubrics_metrics.description: Distribution Statements on DoD Technical Information, January 10, 2023 (DODI 5230.24).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When public materials include or reference technical information, apply appropriate distribution statements and classification guidance per this issuance. Check distribution and dissemination restrictions before releasing technical details in press materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prepublication and Security Review of Privately Written Works (DTM 24-005) and Related DTMs/Memos
rubrics_metrics.description: Prepublication and Security Review of Privately Written Works by Current and Former DoD Personnel, Directive-Type Memorandum (DTM) 24-005, November 8, 2024, and other listed memoranda and DTMs (e.g., Prepublication requirements, Internet Protocol implementation, ethics responsibilities).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Individuals (current or former DoD personnel) must follow prepublication and security-review processes for privately written works and other public statements. Consult the specific DTM for submission procedures, timelines, and required points of contact to ensure compliance before public dissemination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Related policy areas referenced that may affect public releases (FOIA, classification, security, insider threat, CUI)
rubrics_metrics.description: The list includes many other issuances that can affect public communications: e.g., DoD Information Security Program (DODI 5200.01), Personnel Security Program (DODI 5200.02), Controlled Unclassified Information (DODI 5200.48), FOIA program guidance (Administrative Instruction 108), Insider Threat (DODI 5205.16 / DODI 5205.83), and others.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before issuing public statements or releasing documents, review related issuances for classification, CUI handling, FOIA considerations, and insider-threat/security implications. These policies may impose content restrictions, mandatory coordination, or notification/recordkeeping duties that directly affect press-release content and process.
